$meta.title: Relational probability / reconstruction — attempt taxonomy
$meta.purpose: Zoom-out index of the relational-probability / reconstruction collection. Load first for the shape; follow `detail` pointers to drill in.
$meta.what_is_it: The question: can relational morphisms, σ-additive disintegration, or contextuality (OML structure) deliver a NOVEL reconstruction theorem or vocabulary? (Reconstructing a dynamical system's state-space / probabilistic content from observational/relational data.)
$meta.status: ALL ROUTES KILLED. No live research remains — this is an archive-only collection of negative results.
$meta.the_shape: Four distinct routes, each killed on prior-art or triviality: (1) relational predictive/geometric separation = factor-vs-conjugacy (Krieger 1967, published in the audience's venues); (2) distributed-sensor contextuality = empty-or-imported (Kolmogorov/Fine preclude intrinsic incompatibility); (3) L₂ dispersion-free vs homomorphism = textbook Kalmbach; (4) its seed = same. The durable yield is a fence: classical observables always jointly distribute, so genuine OML/contextuality cannot be FORCED by a single classical system's dynamics.
$meta.overlap_note: disintegration_diagnostic.md is NOT in this collection — it is the fibre-mixing statistical instantiation, owned by [[paper_iii_taxonomy]] (fm.geometric_vs_algebraic). Do not double-list.

categories.kill: a route killed on prior-art or triviality
categories.wall: the structural obstruction the kills bottom out at

kills.name: Relational predictive/geometric separation
kills.one_line: Can relational morphisms recover geometric state-space (NO, skew-product) vs probabilistic content (YES, but = Krieger 1967)? The predictive/geometric split IS factor-vs-conjugacy, already published in the audience's own venues (Botvinick–Greenhouse 2025). Type 4/6 bars FAIL.

kills.name: Distributed-sensor contextuality
kills.one_line: DOUBLE KILL — can non-co-realizable multi-sensor observers force a genuine OML? Construction is empty (Kolmogorov: classical observables always jointly distribute) or imported (incompatibility imposed, not intrinsic). Fine 1982 + Kolmogorov rule out intrinsic incompatibility. Type 1/3 FAIL.

kills.name: L₂ dispersion-free vs homomorphism
kills.one_line: Does L₂ split dispersion-free states from 2-valued homomorphisms? Trivially yes — textbook (Kalmbach Chinese lantern, Pták–Pulmannová); σ-additivity is free, so L₂ is decorative. Type 1 FAIL. (Paper II §5 line-304 fix it produced still stands.)

kills.name: L₂ state-space separation seed
kills.one_line: The verified-by-building seed for the L₂ route. Math sound, contribution null (killed via parent). Archaeological record.

walls.name: Classical observables jointly distribute
walls.one_line: Kolmogorov + Fine 1982: a single classical system's observables always admit a joint distribution ⟹ genuine OML/contextuality cannot be INTRINSIC to its dynamics, only imposed. The fence every contextuality-from-dynamics route hits.

settled_facts.name: Predictive/geometric = factor/conjugacy
settled_facts.one_line: The relational predictive-vs-geometric separation is exactly the factor-vs-conjugacy distinction (Krieger 1967; Rokhlin). Not new to the target audience.

actionable.name: Paper II §3 scope caveat
actionable.one_line: Follow-up from the distributed-sensor kill: Paper II §3 should carry a scope caveat — distributed-systems contextuality requires IMPOSED incompatibility, not intrinsic dynamics.

actionable.name: Predictive half belongs upstream to CE
actionable.one_line: Survivor observation from the reconstruction-separation kill: the predictive half depends on CE/Paper-I measure structure, so it belongs to the CE locus, not here.
